SC State Highlights
Relive the excitement of Homecoming 2026!
The memories are still fresh, and the photos are ready! From the parade and tailgating
to the big game and unforgettable celebrations, South Carolina State University's
Homecoming 2026 was packed with Bulldog pride.
Explore our Homecoming 2026 photo galleries, find your favorite moments and download photos to save and share with family, friends and fellow Bulldogs.
#BulldogPride
Construction at SC State
South Carolina State University is amid a multi-million dollar construction program
designed to bring campus facilities up to modern standards. Funded by state and federal
sources, the projects are transforming the historic campus into a 21st century learning
environment.
Check out all the major projects happening at SC State.
EXPLORE SC STATE
Make yourself at home on a campus where you will feel accepted, cared for, and challenged to be your very
best!
Explore SC State
